documents.shelfmark: SOA Plzen, Klaster u Nepomuka, RA Windischgraetz inv. 1433, karton 202 (DECODE R5029)
documents.route: Brussels -> Ernst Friedrich (or Leopold Viktorin) von Windischgraetz

plaintext.source: No reading of this letter on DECODE; read here with Mirka's reconstructed key attached to the record.

transcription.notes: Bracketed clear context excluded from the count.

system.summary: Two numbers per letter (1-48, A=24/36 ... Z=1/37) plus a nomenclator of codes 52-225.
system.notes: Cipher passages embedded in clear German.

prior_solution.where: Mirka's reconstructed key on the DECODE record; no reading of this letter

conditions.human_role: Posed the target from the catalogue.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE R5029's five images, record page and attached xlsx with the project cookie.
Found Jakub Mirka's reconstructed key (2023) as the xlsx on the record itself; the catalogue's suggested keys R5017/R5018 are the Emperor's, not this cipher.
Transcribed the 13 cipher passages (181 groups) by eye from full-resolution crops, clear context in brackets (ct.txt).
Applied Mirka's two-numbers-per-letter table with dec.py: all letter-spelled passages give German (EXCUSATION ZU MACHEN, SUCCESSION, NIEMAHLEN ANZUNEHMEN).
Tried to fix open nomenclator codes (78, 103, 182, 205...) from context; none secure.
Fetched sibling records R5025-R5028 (16 images) with the project cookie.
Scanned all sibling cipher passages for interlinear glosses: 78=Compagnie, 103=Eugen (P.E./Eug.), 99=Engländer, 167=Graf Miosch confirmed; no gloss for the other 19 open codes.
Re-transcribed every cipher line of P2-P5 at full resolution; 4 vs 5 told apart by the c-hook on 5; p5 '9 45 18' corrected to '9 24 18' (GETHAN). All else confirmed.
Bracketed the 19 open codes in the alphabetical nomenclator against every context (182 nicht, 131 haben, 172 mit, 205 Rialp ...); proposals only, not counted as read.
New measure.py: letter runs checked word by word and LM-scored (de-1740s); codes counted only with listed or glossed values. 155/181 = 0.856.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): R5029 linked to ct.txt (numbers with clear context) and dec.txt (dec.py output with Mírka's table, key.tsv)

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): dec.txt read: p2 and p3L build, but p3R-p4R have open codes, guesses and elided clear text in most clauses. R5029 relabelled decoded, not read; class read in part -> not read; method read with known key -> not solved; fraction_read 0.856 -> 0.

outcome.method_basis: Jakub Mírka's reconstructed key (2023), attached to DECODE R5029, was applied unchanged and decrypts every letter-spelled passage; with 19 nomenclator codes open and the clear text of the later pages only excerpted, about half the sentences do not build, so no reading is claimed (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026). The key and the decryption stand.

gaps.detail: no gloss in siblings R5025-R5028; alphabetical bracketing gives proposals only; other brothers' letters in karton 202 not on DECODE

gaps.item: R5029 as a running text (p3R, p4L, p4R, p5L): decoded, not read
gaps.detail: transcribe the clear text around the cipher passages in full from the DECODE images (fetched 5 Oct 2026; reachable with the shared DECODE cookie (targets/bordeaux/decode/cookie.txt)) and write a running German text with a translation

outcome.fraction_read_source: Reading audit, 22 Oct 2026: the one document is decoded, not read, so no tokens are in a document that reads. The earlier 0.856 (measure.py: 155 of 181 groups read as sense) is withdrawn as a reading figure.
outcome.notes: 148 of 181 groups read; 23 nomenclator codes (33 groups) open. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: decoded, not read; class read in part -> not read, method -> not solved, fraction_read 0.856 -> 0.

credits.note: reconstructed key (xlsx on DECODE R5029), applied unchanged

texts.label: R5029, Brussels, 18 Nov 1721
texts.summary: A Windischgrätz brother writes in German with thirteen enciphered passages, read with Jakub Mírka's key from the DECODE record: the Emperor advised making an excuse; [205] holds under hand; everyone, even the Emperor, daily loses love for [103] after the courier brought the Prince's plan; the Congress of Cambrai should open soon and the Madrid courier brought Pozobueno orders on the renunciations. 23 code numbers stay open.
texts.note: Every letter-spelled passage decrypts, and p2 and p3L build sentences, but p3R, p4L and p4R have open code numbers, «?» guesses and elided clear text ("Casse(?) ...", "durchschnid ... «102» ...") in most clauses, so about half the sentences do not build (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026); fix: transcribe the clear text of p3R-p5L in full from the DECODE images and write a running German text with the open codes marked.
